title: Finland – Training and entertainment software development services – HAUS DPS 2026–2030 for Digital Transformation, Innovation and Public Sector Development
description: HAUS Finnish Institute of Public Management Ltd (HAUS) is establishing a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for the period 2026–2030 for the procurement of expert services related to digital transformation, innovation, governance, institutional development and public sector development. The estimated total value of procurements conducted under the DPS during its validity period is approximately EUR 40 million (excluding VAT). The DPS will be used to procure expertise for international development cooperation projects, technical assistance assignments, advisory services, capacity building initiatives, studies, evaluations and other expert services implemented globally. Assignments may be funded by, among others, the European Union, the Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Finland, development finance institutions and other international cooperation partners. The DPS is divided into the following categories: 1. Digital Transformation, Data, Artificial Intelligence & Cybersecurity 2. Governance, Public Sector Development & Capacity Building 3. Innovation, Investment Readiness & Technical Assistance 4. Communications, Media, Creative & Visibility Services The DPS is open to suppliers from Finland and internationally. Suppliers may apply to one or several categories and, once admitted, will have the opportunity to participate in mini-competitions launched throughout the DPS period 2026–2030. Further information regarding the scope, eligibility requirements and application process is provided in the procurement documents.

title: Quality of Service performance of roaming services study
description:
The purpose of this study is to assess the quality-of-service (QoS) performance of mobile network operators under the Roaming Regulation. The study will assess if roaming customers receive the same QoS when roaming as they usually have at home. It will measure the performance of roaming and domestic mobile services against the following minimum QoS parameters: 
(1) data download speed; 
(2) data upload speed; 
(3) latency; and 
(4) available network technology and generation. 

The dataset on roaming subscribers will be compared with the corresponding datasets for:
(i)	the same subscribers in their home network; 
(ii)	domestic subscribers on the visited network; and 
(iii)	other roaming subscribers on the same visited network. 

The findings will support the EC’s analysis of the functioning of the roaming market, including the provision of roaming services at retail and wholesale level as well as the effectiveness of the QoS obligations. The data, analysis and conclusions of the study will feed into the EC’s 2027 review of the roaming market and inform the report to be submitted to the European Parliament and Council in accordance with the Roaming Regulation.

Maximum value of the procurement: 100.000 EUR - Contract duration 5 months.

title: Datenlieferung Radar- und Messdaten an die HVZ Baden-Württemberg
description: Datenbereitstellung für die HVZ: Mit dem Wasserhaushaltsmodell LARSIM werden in der HVZ operationelle Abfluss- und Wassertemperatur-Vorhersagen für die Gewässer in Baden-Württemberg berechnet. Für diese Berechnung benötigt es die Bereitstellung umfangreicher meteorologischer Daten von Wetterdiensten. Zur Verbesserung der Modellberechnungen, insbesondere in Bezug auf die Hochwasserwarnung für kleine Einzugsgebiete nutzt die HVZ räumlich hochaufgelöste Radardaten, um das tatsächliche Niederschlagsgeschehen im Modell so genau wie möglich abzubilden. Neben den gemessenen Niederschlagdaten, werden auch meteorologische Vorhersagen für den operationellen Modellbetrieb benötigt. Datenbereitstellung für FLIWAS: Des Weiteren muss auch das Flutinformations- und Warnsystem (FLIWAS) mit Niederschlagsdaten beliefert werden. FLIWAS versorgt Kommunen und Behörden mit detaillierten Informationen im Falle eines Hochwassers. Niederschlagsmenge und -dauer sind bei einem Hochwasser zentrale Informationen, um die aktuelle Lage beurteilen zu können. Im Gegensatz zu bodennahen Niederschlagsstationen mit punktuellen Messungen ermöglichen moderne Radarmessungen eine flächenhafte Beurteilung der Niederschlagsverteilung.
